text:
Maya Patel: Quick flag on the Compliance > Privacy mock. three tiny but important nits: the encryption badge copy, retention live announcements, and the audit search placeholder. Samir Khan: show me the screencap? Maya Patel: attached in figma. pill currently says 'Encrypted' with tooltip 'Managed by Redwood KMS' even for BYOK rows. confuses customers. Olivia Reed: propose pill variants: 'Encrypted (Redwood)' and 'Encrypted (Customer)'. tooltip: 'Redwood-managed key' vs 'Customer-managed (BYOK)'. keeps pill short. Sophie Chen: accessibility: pill isn't in tab order before card actions and has no visible focus ring. keyboard users can't tell where they are. also retention slider aria-live reads only the number (e.g., "30") instead of unit. needs to announce '30 days'. Alex Gómez: region dropdown is alphabetical in the mock; we should show user-preferred region first then fall back to latency-sorted list. small UX improvement. Maya Patel: audit placeholder currently 'search events...'. customers ask what fields they can search. suggest: 'Search events, user email, or key ID'. Samir Khan: frontend can add aria-live snippet for retention. small code:
Retention: 30 days
. Backend unchanged. Olivia Reed: CTA copy on the enable modal is ambiguous: 'Enable encryption' also binds keys for BYOK. recommend two CTAs: 'Enable (Redwood-managed)' and 'Bind key & enable'. add helper line: 'Pick a key or use Redwood-managed. Encrypts stored data.' Sophie Chen: contrast check: current pill hover fail ~3.2:1. need >=4.5:1. solution: darken text ~18% and keep bg. I'll post exact hex deltas. design-bot: updated figma: https://figma.com/file/rx/privacy-panel-v6 includes pill labels, region pref, new placeholders, split CTAs, and focus ring. Maya Patel: can everyone review today? aiming for next console patch. Samir Khan: I can look after 4pm PT. Olivia Reed: i'll do copy + a11y pass by EOD. Sophie Chen: i'll run keyboard walkthrough tomorrow AM and post results. Alex Gómez: will add color numbers and a contrast regression test to QA checklist.
